verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page documents a built-in AI that gives 'instant AI answers' about transactions and cash flow and can 'run scenarios', so an in-product AI assistant exists. Its documented scope is Q&A and scenario modeling rather than delegating tasks for it to carry out. Delegation elsewhere in the evidence is to human accountants and CFOs, which does not count toward an AI assistant. Missing for 10: evidence the AI assistant executes delegated tasks or actions, documentation of its interface and capabilities beyond one line, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios to plan ahead
